@graph.headline: Recommended Phrases and Page Elements for Home Builder Website SEO
@graph.description: Use this home builder website SEO checklist to map phrases to real pages, improve titles and headings, add proof and links, validate schema, and avoid stuffing.

mainEntity.name: What phrases should a home builder use for SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use accurate phrases that describe the page's real audience, service, market, project, process, or question. Assign each phrase family to one clear page owner.

mainEntity.name: How many times should a keyword appear on a page?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no useful universal count. Use the phrase where it improves clarity and support the topic with natural language, evidence, related questions, and descriptive links.

mainEntity.name: Should every target keyword have its own page?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Combine close variations that serve the same reader job. Create a separate page only when the intent, evidence, and conversion path are meaningfully distinct.
Structured data can help systems understand content and may enable eligible search features, but it does not guarantee rankings or rich results.

mainEntity.name: When should a page be refreshed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Refresh it when facts, services, markets, sources, project proof, platform guidance, links, or buyer questions change, and on the review cadence assigned before publication.
